title: div:ide Cyber Drill Platform
description: A Proxmox-backed cyber drill platform for managing repeatable red-team and blue-team exercises, scenario definitions, telemetry, and operational reporting.

sections.title: What I Built
content: This project turns a security lab into a repeatable exercise platform. It combines a web portal, API services, scenario schemas, database migrations, deployment configuration, and Proxmox integration into one operational workflow.
The platform is designed around controlled exercises rather than isolated demonstrations, making it possible to define scenarios, run drills, observe outcomes, and improve the next iteration.

sections.title: Engineering and Security Value
content: The repository demonstrates full-stack security engineering across Docker, Flask, PostgreSQL, Proxmox, Prometheus, Grafana, CI, and API documentation.

Its strongest portfolio value is the connection between infrastructure and learning outcomes: offensive actions can be exercised inside a controlled environment while defensive teams measure visibility, response, and operational readiness.

sections.title: Next Evidence to Add
content: The case study should eventually include an architecture diagram, a sanitized exercise flow, and a screenshot of the drill dashboard. Sensitive infrastructure credentials and live host details should remain excluded.
